description: This Java class provides a provider for various queue producers used in the Thingsboard server, specifically for core queue messaging. It initializes and exposes methods to access different message producers for transport, rule engine, core, edge, usage stats, version control, housekeeper, and calculated fields.

classes.name: TbCoreQueueProducerProvider
classes.description: A provider class that initializes and supplies various queue message producers for the Thingsboard core services.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes all queue message producers after construction.

methods.name: getTransportNotificationsMsgProducer
methods.description: Returns the producer for transport notification messages.

methods.name: getTbCoreMsgProducer

methods.name: getTbCoreNotificationsMsgProducer

methods.name: getTbUsageStatsMsgProducer
